trace.question: Text everyone who gave us a phone number: 10% off pho this weekend.

- **Wording:** It names the restaurant and ends with the STOP line. [Customer Messaging Policy §6, Required Wording]
- **Timing:** It must go out between 9am and 8pm local time. [Customer Messaging Policy §3, Quiet Hours]

The system's checks on discount, wording and audience all passed.
